entities.name: SNAr of 2-chloro-3-nitropyridine
observations: Base-assisted aromatic nucleophilic substitution replaces C-Cl with N-substituent from 1-aminopropan-2-ol; triethylamine scavenges HCl and ethanol is solvent.
Database matches support 2-anilino-3-nitropyridine formation from the same substrate; a free primary amine favors C-N substitution over O-substitution.
